title: Turn the Ship Around
story: The Ship Going the Other Way
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Lord said, "Jonah, go and speak
To Nineveh for Me."
But Jonah turned and ran away
And sailed across the sea.

[Chorus]
Oh, turn around, oh, turn around,
There's nowhere you can hide;
Your Father knows just where you are,
And He is at your side.

[Verse 2]
The wind blew hard, the waves rolled high,
The sailors cried in fear;
But Jonah hid down in the hold
And did not want to hear.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The captain shook him, "Get up now,
And pray to God with me!"
For no one sails so far away
That He can't hear or see.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Beau spilled the crackers on the floor,
His feet said, "Run away!"
But he turned round and found the broom,
And I'll be brave today.

[Chorus]
mood: Rowing music. A steady two-beat pull under the voice, like oars dipping and lifting on open water while a small boat turns slowly back toward the shore. Cello carrying the swell underneath, fingerpicked nylon guitar marking each stroke, a low gentle baritone close and unhurried. Brave and plain rather than stormy, steadier with every verse, until the last one lands on dry ground in the middle of the day.
